chunks: My responsibility for what I say is guaranteed and I am answerable for it.
He to whom experiences have clearly shown the past exemplary punishments (given by Allāh to peoples) is prevented by piety from falling into doubts.
You should know that the same troubles have returned to you which existed when the Prophet was first sent.

key_terms.العِبَرُ: Lessons or signs from past events
key_terms.رَهِينَةٌ: Hostage or held in pledge (metaphor for guarantee)

ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between reflection on past punishments and piety in preventing doubt?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) pledges his own honor as a guarantee for the veracity of his words, asserting that those who heed the lessons of past divine punishments are shielded by piety from falling into doubt. He warns that the trials facing the people have returned to their original state as they were when the Prophet was first sent, highlighting the cyclical nature of spiritual decline and the urgency of repentance in the context of his caliphate.
